description: Find the fixed-price daily lunch special ("meniul zilei") that Iași restaurants publish for a given day, ranked by date, diet, zone, price, or text query. Use this only for the set lunch-of-the-day menu — for "where should I eat", "unde mâncăm", or any request to recommend a good restaurant/place to eat, use recommend_restaurants instead.
name: find_daily_menus
